svg.title: Compass Platform Capability Roadmap
svg.desc: Executive infographic showing the Compass Surfaces, Spine, and Brain architecture, whole-capability delivery contract, six ordered milestones, and common release gates.

g.text: Compass connects Member, CSR, and Provider experiences to reusable
healthcare capabilities—one complete product increment at a time.
CSR Chat becomes a Compass surface.
move through the shared platform contract.
Move from surface-specific conversational delivery to a shared
capability model—without turning the roadmap into a migration chain.
Benefits Inquiry is the reference flow.
CSR Chat is in flight across surface,
Benefits Inquiry establishes the reference foundation; every milestone adds value and platform strength.
Eligible inquiries correctly resolved with trusted
evidence, appropriate context, and a usable answer.
A capability is complete only when experience, intelligence,
trust controls, and operations can stand on their own.
Surface-initiated by default; agent-recommended when configured.
The baseline sequence compounds learning—from grounded answers
and contextual authorization to high-assurance transactions.
Baseline sequence: value first, then progressively richer context and action assurance.
Capability units may move as a whole.
Resolve coverage status, dates, plan context, and restrictions
for the right person at the right point in time.
actor vs. subject auth · provider access · point-in-time context
Explain status, adjudication, member responsibility, denial
context, and next steps across multiple records.
PHI minimization · record clarification · explainable codes
Ground deductible and out-of-pocket balances by individual
or family, network, benefit period, and authoritative as-of date.
Clarify drug coverage, tier, prior authorization, step therapy,
and quantity limits within explicit clinical boundaries.
entity normalization · policy versions · clinical boundaries
Find and rank providers using specialty, location, network,
Find availability and safely book, reschedule, or cancel with
explicit confirmation and transparent action status.
Quality is shared. Release is independent.
Every side effect is authorized, idempotent, confirmed, and audited; capability SLOs approved before release.
Missing capabilities stay safe and transparent.
Enable by tenant, surface, and version.
